headline: Kenya National Treasury Prepares 2027 Tax Reforms Across PAYE, VAT, and Corporate Levies
summary: Kenya's National Treasury is preparing its second Medium-Term Revenue Strategy (MTRS) to broaden the national tax base and improve compliance through changes to personal income tax (PAYE), VAT, and corporate tax rates.
why: The National Treasury manages Kenya's public debt, national budget, and taxation policies.
